description: This file is a Makefile for managing feed packages in an embedded Linux build system, specifically related to OpenWrt/LEDE. It includes variable definitions, conditional logic for package directories, feed sources, and package file matching patterns for ipk and apk packages.

methods.name: FeedPackageDir
methods.description: Determines the directory path for a package feed, conditionally based on configuration variables.

methods.name: FeedSourcesAppendOPKG
methods.description: Generates script lines to append package source URLs for opkg package manager, dynamically based on configuration.

methods.name: FeedSourcesAppendAPK
methods.description: Generates script lines to append package source URLs for APK package manager, dynamically based on configuration.

methods.name: GetABISuffix
methods.description: Returns the ABI suffix for a package, either from predefined variables or by formatting version info.

methods.name: FormatABISuffix
methods.description: Formats an ABI suffix string based on package name and version information.
